This solution, Hydrological Status and Outlook System for Integrated Water Resources Management and Climate Resilience in Bangladesh and Nepal (HydroSOS‑BaNe) addresses natural catastrophe in Bangladesh, 
Nepal between Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD), Bangladesh Water Development Board (BWDB), Department of Hydrology and Meteorology (DHM), and World Meteorological Organization (WMO). The program was implemented in Cannot be determined and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
